title: Boots for the Road
html:
Nessa has promised lined boots to the patrol, but the woodcutters' delivery is late and Bram keeps adding names to the order.

About

Given byNessa Holt
Level8
LengthLong
KindSide
Quest points2

What you need

  • Wolf Pelt ×5
  • Wool ×6

Steps

  1. Talk to Nessa Holt (outdoors near Binxonia) to get the quest.
  2. Bring Nessa Holt 5 Wolf Pelts from wolves south of Binxonia.
  3. Ask the Lumberjack Trainer about Nessa’s delivery.
  4. Kill 6 small coral snakes on the western approach.
  5. Tell the Lumberjack Trainer the approach is clear.
  6. Bring Nessa Holt 6 Wool for the boot linings.
  7. Ask Bram Fen about the patrol’s new boots.
  8. Go back to Nessa Holt with Bram’s answer to finish the quest.

Rewards

Reward
Gold200
Character XP6,500
Quest points2

What Nessa Holt says

Nessa Holt: These pelts will do for Bram's boots. I'll start cutting them while you're out.

Nessa Holt: The Lumberjack Trainer still hasn't brought my delivery. Go and ask what's holding him up. I need it before I can finish the order.

Lumberjack Trainer: I haven't forgotten Nessa's delivery. The cutters won't take the load past those small coral snakes west of town.

Lumberjack Trainer: Clear six of them from the approach, then come back and tell me. I'll see that she gets her delivery.

Lumberjack Trainer: Good. I'll bring the load to Nessa myself. She still needs six wool for the boot linings, so take those to her while I get moving.

Nessa Holt: That's the lining sorted. I'll send the finished boots out with the next patrol.

Nessa Holt: Ask Bram how they fit after he's walked in them. I want to hear about a bad seam before it wears through someone's heel.

Bram Fen: A full circuit and not a blister. Tell Nessa they fit. She'll want more of an answer than me turning up for another pair.

Nessa Holt: Bram has his boots, the cutters have their path, and I have paid you. I'm closing the shop before anyone else thinks of something.

Handing it in

"Bram has his boots, the cutters have their path, and I have paid you. I'm closing the shop before anyone else thinks of something."
